subject: 🏃 Friday — Stability & Power (Wk 3)
html:
Tomorrow: Stability & Power at Cañada College. Full Rx session — Bulgarian split squats, single-leg RDLs (contralateral), Spanish squat holds, Copenhagen planks, plus the PT block (side plank w/ hip abduction, dead bug w/ banded pulldown, chin tuck + lifts). No running.

Dynamic warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band (1 min each side), 90/90 PAILs (30 sec each side), banded lateral walks (10 each direction), Spanish squat hold (30 sec), Copenhagen plank (20 sec each side).

Recommended weights (3 sets × 8–10 reps per side):

  • Bulgarian split squat: 20 lb/hand — 3-sec eccentric, hips square
  • Single-leg RDL: 25 lb single DB, contralateral hand — keep the anti-rotation challenge, free hand reaches forward, 3-sec eccentric
  • Spanish squat hold: Light band, 3 × 30–45 sec — vertical shin, deep knee bend
  • Copenhagen plank: BW, 3 × 30 sec each side (top of range — next time consider +5 sec or shin-on-bench progression)
  • Side plank w/ hip abd (PT): 8 reps each side, top toe pointing to floor
  • Dead bug w/ banded pulldown (PT): 2–3 × 10 slow marches
  • Chin tuck + lifts (PT): 2 reps each direction (front, diag L, diag R), 3-sec hold

Focus cue: On the single-leg RDLs, this is the first session at 25 lb contralateral — the jump from 20. Stay slow through the eccentric and prioritize the anti-rotation demand. If balance breaks, pause and reset rather than switching to bilateral. That rotational stability is exactly what your PT flagged.

Context: Week 3 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 65 days to race day. Yesterday's compressed progression run was excellent: mile 4 hit 7:29 at HR 161, a cleaner threshold rep than Week 2's 7:38 at 159. Knee 1/5 throughout. You're stacking clean sessions — four straight at 1/5 since the B2B 2/5 reading. The PAL 10K is 8 days out; this is the last full-Rx stability session before the taper-week deload.

Tonight: Lay out gym clothes and the resistance band. Protein-forward dinner — aim for 30–40g (fish + rice bowl, lentil soup, or eggs). Bed by 10.
